text:
The Season’s Saddest Day | Episode 304 | Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
Aryan Simhadri (Grover Underwood) and fellow castmates, Olive Abercrombie (Bianca) and Levi Chrisopulos (Nico), discuss a pivotal turning point for the show. Both actors share how they auditioned and got their roles. A process that Olive felt might mirror her character's own experience being thrown into a quest. Dior Goodjohn (Clarisse La Rue) stops by to discuss her character's relationship to Nico, and how season 3 is a personal redemption arc for her after The Sea of Monsters.

All Hail the Hunters | Episode 303 | Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
Join Aryan Simhadri (Grover Underwood) as he and Saara Chaudry (Zoë Nightshade) discuss the quest that anchors episode three. The cast does a deep dive into character preparation, the Zoë/Artemis partnership, and what it takes to recreate a two-story set complete with authentic snacks. David Costabile (Dr. Thorn) stops by to discuss Thorn's want for more power and David's very personal connection to the series source materials.
